name: Two-tone sandwich focus ring
technique: outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset:2px; box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--focus-halo), 0 0 24px 6px var(--focus-glow). Inside .on-deep scopes the ring/halo swap to focus.ring-on-deep / focus.halo-on-deep. :focus-visible only.
fallback: forced-colors: outline 2px solid Highlight, box-shadow none.
a11y: MANDATORY. Best tone >= 3:1 on every surface incl. art extremes and the brand button (min 3.80 light, 5.33 dark); ring vs halo 10.30 / 7.55. scroll-padding keeps it unobscured (2.4.11).

name: Shared motion gate (95-motion.css)
technique: One file holds every tier gate: --dur-t0/--dur-t1 zeroed under reduce (unless data-motion=on) and under data-motion=off; T2 and T4 key off html[data-alive]; T1 off JS state attributes set only when prefs.motionOn(); reduce backstop sets animation:none on [data-t2] unless data-motion=on.
a11y: WCAG 2.2.2 (pause), 2.3.3. 0 infinite animations with motion off or reduce+no choice (J2 gate 1).

name: Living night cove / dawn hero scene
technique: <=6 OUTER layer boxes (HTML wrapper div > inner <svg>, shared viewBox 0 0 1600 400, xMidYMax slice) over a static CSS sky gradient: aurora wrap, stars (masked behind copy), moon/sun, far+mid ranges with tonal fills, water+glints, near shore+bioluminescent surf, fore firs, mist band, fireflies/dew. Loops: transform/opacity on the inner <svg> only. Theme swaps --sc-* vars only (one DOM).
tier: T1 entrance + T2 loops (<=7 in hero viewport)
fallback: Static frame (no JS, reduce, Animations off) is fully composed: ranges filled, surf lit, fireflies visible at rest opacity.
a11y: aria-hidden; visible "Illustration" chip; H1 is LCP and never animated; copy never overlaps land (light ink-2 over far range = 4.32 forbidden); stars/glints masked to 10% behind copy; fireflies <= 0.5 Hz; no flashing.
source: P1 base; J3 fixes; P2 masks; P3 wrapper split

name: Land settles into place (dolly-in)
technique: HTML land wrapper: scale 1.04 -> 1 over 1.4s, ease-out, triggered by [data-entered] which living.js sets on the first rAF after load (never during the LCP window). Separate property from parallax translate; inner <svg> keeps transform for drift.
a11y: Transform only, no CLS; skipped when motion is not effective.
source: P3/J3 (replaces P1 translate rise, J2 V9)

name: Hero depth parallax
technique: animation-timeline: scroll(root); animation-range: 0 100vh; translate on <=5 HTML wrappers (never on <svg>), depths .04-.15. Inside @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) and html[data-alive].
a11y: Vestibular: off under reduce/Animations off; small amplitude (<= 15% of land height); no scroll-jacking.

name: Glowing contour lines on the headland
technique: 2-4 contour paths following the near/mid ridges, pathLength=1, one-shot stroke-dashoffset draw <=1.6s, started by living.js after load+idle ([data-drawn]); glow baked as a second wider low-opacity stroke (no drop-shadow, no filter).
a11y: Decorative; never under copy; not a loop.

name: Mist and fore-ridge fade into the page
technique: Static: fore ridge silhouette plus a mist gradient band ending in var(--color-bg); never a straight cut.
a11y: None needed.

name: Theme-reactive vignettes (service, area, project, "Not sure?", "Where we work")
technique: Small inline SVGs drawn with the hero hand and --sc-* vars; shared <symbol> firs; per-service motifs (mown stripes, terraces+flagstones, drip line with droplets, fir with pruning cut / tree rings); per-project cottage-and-path template seeded by project slug. Static.
a11y: aria-hidden + "Illustration" chip where it could be mistaken for a photo; no fake data; no empty wells.
source: P1 hand + P3 subjects + P2 motifs

name: 13 distinct municipality scenes
technique: livingScene("area:<slug>") reads the art.mjs AREAS recipe (water sea|lake|none, distant range|islands|hills, trees, horizon, orb x) and renders the night/dawn layer system with <=5 loops (aurora, stars, glints, mist, fireflies).
a11y: Same as living-hero. Scene choices are landform cues only, never claims about the place.

name: Service page hero scene
technique: Same engine, 4 layers + the service motif as the foreground; <=4 loops (aurora, fireflies, glints, mist).
a11y: Same as living-hero.

name: One-shot section reveals
technique: living.js IntersectionObserver arms [data-reveal] below the first viewport (data-reveal="armed": opacity .4, translate 0 24px), flips to "in" once (600ms transition), then unobserves. Section wrappers only.
fallback: Always visible; no JS = never armed.
a11y: Never on H1/LCP or first-viewport content; never from opacity 0; content readable mid-transition.
labVerdict: safe-ish (+11 ms/s scroll vs +36 for view())

name: Cursor spotlight on bento tiles
technique: One passive rAF-throttled pointermove on the grid; per hovered tile, one aria-hidden glow child (radial glow.spot) moved by translate3d. Never sets vars on :root.
a11y: (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) only, and only when prefs.motionOn(); purely decorative.
labVerdict: ration (+43 ms/s while pointer moves, transform version)

name: Gradient rim on tile hover/focus
technique: Tile ::after ring (1px, mask-composite exclude) filled with surface.edge (moss -> sea-glass -> honey); opacity 0 -> 1 on :hover/:focus-within (T0). The spotlight child also lights the rim where the pointer is.
a11y: No violet (focus colour stays unique); decorative; focus ring is separate and always on top.

name: 3px lift on tile hover
technique: translate 0 -3px + shadow change, var(--dur-t0).
a11y: Instant under reduce/off.

name: Comet ring on the CTA band primary button
technique: Oversized conic-gradient child (inset:-50%) rotated by transform (14s linear infinite) inside an overflow:hidden capsule, inner surface 2px in. 1 per page by default, 2 max (styleguide only shows 2).
a11y: Never @property; pauses off-screen; counts toward 8 loops per viewport; button text sits on solid brand.

name: Living CTA band ("a window into the night")
technique: Deep band in both themes (.on-deep scope): 3 pre-blurred radial-gradient blobs moved by transform (26/32/40s), static contour rings from 3 real TILES polygons (survey.contour-faint), static grain, fixed scrim under the copy. Copy: Newsreader accent line + reply promise + trust micro-line.
a11y: on-deep-2 >= 8.81 over blob peaks with scrim; focus uses ring-on-deep; no filter: blur.

name: Static grain on deep bands
technique: <=1 KB PNG data-URI tile at 4-5% opacity, no blend modes, never animated, never background-attachment:fixed.
fallback: Removed under prefers-contrast:more, reduced transparency and forced-colors.
a11y: Never behind small text on light surfaces.

name: Static "spatial floor" under bento grids
technique: Pre-blurred radial glows (glow.moss/sea, honey in light) plus a radial-masked 48px hairline grid behind the grid gaps. Never animated, never behind text.
a11y: Decorative only.

name: Lit-solid cards
technique: Opaque surface.card / card-hi gradients + glass.rim inset highlight + glass.edge hairline + sheen. No backdrop-filter.
a11y: Contrast computed per gradient stop and under spotlight peak (ink-3 min 5.10 dark, 4.95 light worst text pair).

name: Header capsule glass
technique: material.chrome fill; real backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(1.5) ONLY when html[data-scrolled] (past the hero) and NOT [data-header-over-living] (ds-chrome IO on [data-living] elements under the header strip).
fallback: Fill alone (alpha .82 dark / .84 light) carries contrast; solid under reduced transparency.
a11y: Contrast checked with no blur over art extremes; <= 1 backdrop-filter element per mobile viewport.
labVerdict: ration over static content; avoid over animated (J2 V2)

name: Dark theme / Animations toggles
technique: Two aria-pressed buttons. >= 80em: pill with icon + visible label + state dot (filled brand = on, hollow ink-2 ring = off); labels start at 80em because nav + labelled pills + Free quote do not fit at 64-80em (measured). < 80em: 44x44 icon buttons keep the dot as a corner badge; the label is the same text node, visually hidden. Icons: moon (theme), three fireflies (animations).
a11y: State is shape (filled vs hollow) + aria-pressed, not colour alone (1.4.1); dot >= 3:1 (min 6.67); one name source, no aria-label duplication; 44x44.
source: P2 dot + P1/P3 icon buttons (J2 V5, V6)

name: Moonrise theme reveal
technique: document.startViewTransition; ::view-transition-new(root) clip-path circle grows from the toggle (--vt-x/--vt-y), 520ms; updates <meta name=theme-color>.
a11y: Only when prefs.motionOn(); focus stays on the toggle; no flashing (dark->light is a wipe, not a flash).

name: Cross-document crossfade + title morph
technique: @view-transition{navigation:auto} inside (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference); names: site-header, page-title (max 3); pageswap moves page-title from the old H1 to the clicked card title so it morphs into the new H1; 250ms.
a11y: Pseudo-elements animation:none under [data-motion=off]; never name living layers or images.
labVerdict: ration (+134 ms main thread per navigation)

name: Sticky Call / Free quote bar (< 64em)
technique: Solid material.thick bar (no blur), glass rim on top, two equal 48px buttons; translateY in/out var(--dur-t0); hidden while hero actions, [data-quote-form] or the on-screen keyboard are in view; always shown with no JS.
a11y: safe-area-inset-bottom; scroll-padding-bottom = bar height (2.4.11); Call reads "Contact" until [PHONE] resolves.

name: "Where we work" tile: 13 named municipalities
technique: 13 chip links (the keyboard path) + a constellation of dots placed from real lon/lat; :has() lights the matching dot on chip hover/focus; "Sidney to Sooke" in prose.
a11y: Chips are the accessible route; dots aria-hidden; names always visible (J1 must-fix 5).

name: "Next step" card beside the hero art (>= 64em)
technique: Lit-solid (material.thick fill, no blur) link card over the sky: "Free quote" + "We get back to you within [REPLY TIME]". Second depth plane.
a11y: It is a real link to /free-quote/ (J1 must-fix 4); contrast checked over orb/aurora.

name: Glowing interactive area map
technique: TILES polygons as contour hills (3 inset rings each), municipality names on the plate; hover/focus (via the list) switches a drop-shadow on instantly on ONE tile, fill/stroke transition T0; current area pulse = aria-hidden HTML glow box animated by opacity (T2, 1 loop). "Schematic, not to scale".
a11y: One keyboard path: the list; tiles tabindex=-1 mirrored via :has(); names visible.
source: P2 plate (no grid letters, no S-codes) + P1 glow

name: Contour plate draw-in
technique: IO-triggered one-shot stroke-dashoffset, <=12 paths, <=1.6s, after the map enters view.
a11y: Never on page load, never looping.

name: Projects filter re-sort
technique: Links work without JS; with JS, startViewTransition with per-card view-transition-name (<= 24 cards), 250ms.
a11y: Focus kept on the filter control; result count announced in a polite live region.

name: Before/after comparison
technique: Keyboard range input drives a clip-path; "Side by side" toggle swaps layout with a 250ms same-document VT.
a11y: Range has a name and value text; works at 320; no drag-only interaction.

name: Path of fireflies (process timeline)
technique: One spine path drawn once (IO, <=1.6s); each step node lights once (opacity glow 600ms).
a11y: Numbers are step labels, not counters.

name: Service sticky TOC firefly marker
technique: Active TOC item gets a 6px moss dot with glow; IO sets aria-current="true"; transition var(--dur-t0).
a11y: Active state is shape + aria-current, not colour alone.

name: Guide reading progress filament
technique: 2px bar under the header, scaleX via animation-timeline: scroll(root), inside @supports and html[data-alive].
a11y: aria-hidden; decorative.

name: "Off the map" 404
technique: Static contour plate of the 13 tiles with no marker, a hairline compass rose, area and service links.
a11y: Links are the content; plate aria-hidden.

name: Calm quote page
technique: Still scene variant (data-still: no T2) behind the header only; no ambient motion near inputs; ready panel enters once (T1 260ms).
a11y: Nothing moves near the form; sticky bar hidden while the form is in view.
